name: Tranche Scaling & De-Risking
known_limitations: Lite has no approved TradePlan producer or gate runtime.
notes: Legacy six-gates-production-v1 is selected active V1; this Lite artifact is review-required knowledge only. Unresolved tranche configuration => INSUFFICIENT_DATA; missing plan is FAIL in V1, not a permissive UNKNOWN.

details.purpose: Require an analytical plan compatible with selected V1 tranche and breakeven policy.

pass_condition.description: Trade plan has entry/structural stop/T1 and is compatible with 0.50 initial tranche, 0.50 T1 reduction, and documented breakeven conditions.

fail_condition.description: Missing/invalid entry-stop-T1 plan or plan conflicts with approved tranche/breakeven policy.

details.score_interaction: Plan admissibility is independent of score; score/LLM cannot override FAIL.
details.strategy_interaction: Consumes an independently governed setup/TradePlan; does not extract strategy entry/stop/target rules here.
details.portfolio_context: Tranche semantics only; no actual sizing or portfolio mutation.
known_limitations: Lite has no approved TradePlan producer or gate runtime.
